topic: restore faded color on leather shoes
core_question: How do I bring faded color back to a pair of leather shoes?
answer_summary: Clean the leather thoroughly, apply a color-matched leather dye in thin, even coats with a dauber or cloth, letting each coat dry, then seal and buff to restore even, saturated color.
